mentions.name: Slide Puzzles
mentions.description: A slide-puzzle game for highly knowledgeable players in which tiles must be arranged by factual ordering criteria, such as sorting chemical elements by atomic number or countries by surface area.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been putting together a rather silly slide-puzzle game for MENSA-level players: things like arranging the tiles by chemical element name according to atomic number, arranging countries by surface area, etc.
